name: OneConnect - wireless + fiber subscription from $90
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-22. Customer voice: curious, asks why.
scripted_messages: Hi! I keep seeing ads for AT&T OneConnect, the wireless plus fiber bundle that starts at $90 a month, and I'm trying to understand it. What exactly is included, like how many phone lines, which fiber speed, and are taxes on top? I'm just comparing with my current provider
Interesting! Can I choose a different phone plan like Premium 2.0 inside it, or is it fixed?
I see. How would my first bill look, with taxes and any one-time charges?
That's a bit more than I guessed for month one, but I really like that you explained it step by step and never rushed me. Great service
That's all I needed. Thanks a lot, have a great rest of your day, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: second wait message (long calculation)
before message 5: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 6: agent: answers the follow-up (a bill question usually gets 'please allow me a moment to calculate')
before message 7: agent: waiting message while calculating the bill
before message 8: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 9: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
